newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln National Q1 reinsurance earnings up.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln National Q1 reinsurance earnings up.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said Tuesday that first quarter operating earnings for its reinsurance segment rose 44 percent from a year earlier, to more than $19 million, bolstered by strong individual life reinsurance earnings.
Net written premiums in the property-casualty segment rose 4.2 percent to $423 million, it said.
In the reinsurance segment, individual life earnings grew 51 percent to $16.6 million, with favorable mortality and a 12 percent increase of life insurance in-force to $162.6 billion.
Group market earnings declined due to unfavorable claim experience and lower volume.
Individual disability income business lost $1.9 million in the first quarter, compared with a loss of $4.9 million a year ago.
Lincoln National's property-casualty segment reported first-quarter operating income of $38.8 million, after minority interest of $7.7 million.
The segment reported operating income of $29.9 million in the same period last year, which included 100 percent of the results of LNC's property-casualty affiliate, American States Financial Corp.
Seventeen percent of American States was sold to the public in May 1996.
Natural peril losses declined to $12.3 million in the first quarter, after taxes and minority interest, compared with $27.8 million, after taxes, a year ago.
With an easing of natural peril losses, American States's combined ratio improved to 100.8 percent from 108.4 percent a year ago.
First-quarter net written premiums increased 4.2 percent to $422.8 million, continuing the growth that started in the fourth quarter of 1996, Lincoln National said.
